summary: Reviewed every enriched change in units 76-111 against the pre-enrichment file. No wrong identification found: caturaṃgula=Cassia fistula, drākṣā=Vitis vinifera, dhātrī=āmalakī, trivṛt=Operculina turpethum, sauvīraka=sour fermented barley drink (probable), kulattha, yava, daśamūla list, rodhra=lodhra, kola=Ziziphus jujuba (probable), mastu=whey, meṣaśṛṅgī=Gymnema sylvestre (probable), abhayā, kṛṣṇā, citraka, sudhā=snuhī/Euphorbia (species disputed), pāṇḍu, dūṣīviṣa, madhumeha are all acceptable and their tags are honest or cautious. Hindi names (अमलतास, आँवला, निसोथ, कुलथी, लोध, मेढ़ासिंगी, हरड़, पीपर, चीता, थूहर, बेर, चीनी) are correct; no Latin or brackets in any Hindi. No effect, dose or identification is smuggled into a translation as text content; identifications are in 'X (Y)' / 'X यानी Y' form beside the kept Sanskrit term. Damaged units 79, 99, 100, 105 untouched; 76 and 107 enriched only on the clear words (caturaṃgula; gulma, madhumeha) - acceptable. Unit 90 Hindi unchanged (self-replacement harmless). Issues are all minor: stale 'not identified' notes now contradicting appended identifications (85, 98, 104), inconsistent coverage (caturaṃgula in 83/86, English of 104 and 108), one misleading phrase (90 'wild croton relative'), one overconfident translation line (98 Gymnema without 'probably'), tilvaka/rodhra caution (92), udara vs glossary (107, owner decision), spelling हल्के. No regrouping suggested.
